zxMusic.title: In web of affairs
zxMusic.description:
https://csi.pdp-11.ru/kuvomus.html?wid=990

The morning starts with an alarm clock that's already late. The day starts with a to-do list that grows faster than you can complete it. The evening starts with the thought, "What have I accomplished today?" We've become so accustomed to running that we've forgotten how to walk, and we've never even heard of "standing and enjoying." Maybe it's time to pause? At least for five minutes, and to ponder the fact that we are rushing forward, barely noticing the moments: calls, messages, deadlines, meetings... Day merges with day, the speed increases - and we are less and less often stop to breathe deeply, look into the eyes of a loved one or listen to yourself. In this eternal race, it is so easy to forget that life is not a time-limit marathon, but a series of fragile, precious moments. Moments of joy of meeting with family people...
